## Use case

What concrete problem are you trying to solve, and who needs this behavior?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the result, compatibility/operational implications and any alternatives considered.
A small example is helpful; an implementation design is optional.

## Scope and verification

Which repository/layer should own this, and how could its behavior be verified?
